input.message: Compressor 2 is overheating right now and the temperature keeps climbing.
Compressor 2 overheated this morning; the technician replaced the fan and it has run at normal temperature since.
Compressor 2 overheated this morning. Someone worked on it but I do not know whether the repair held.
Pump A is running hot at 95 C and the alarm is still active.
Pump A ran hot yesterday; the seal was replaced and the temperature is back to 60 C and stable.
Pump A ran hot yesterday. I have not heard anything about it since.
The night operator called to say the curing oven on line 3 is overheating at this moment.
The night operator says the curing oven on line 3 overheated but maintenance fixed the thermostat and it is fine now.
The night operator mentioned the curing oven on line 3 overheated at some point; nobody told him what happened next.

Rack B7 had an inlet temperature spike last night. Is it still a problem? The dashboard is down so I cannot tell.

The generator overheated last week. A sticker on it says "Repaired - continue operation", but nobody can confirm a repair happened.
Motor 12 smells burnt and is too hot to touch; it is still running.

One shift says the kiln repair is finished, another says it is still pending. I cannot tell which is right.
Battery bank 2 is overheating and swelling at this moment.

Battery bank 2 overheated earlier today. Status of the repair is unknown to me.

The laser cutter chiller overheated yesterday. I do not know what was done about it.

The welding robot overheated. The ticket is closed but the comment field is empty, so I do not know if it was actually fixed.
The UPS in room 2 is overheating right now; its fans are failing.
